QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] Returning to Aspire
QuestInfo.0: Head to the Wondroids Hideout with #bSpencer#k and find out what happened.
QuestInfo.2: You heard disturbing news from #bKhun#k, a former Aspire employee whose body has been unwillingly grafted with machine parts, that the shut-down Aspire facility has recently stirred back to life. But... if there's no one in the factory, who's running it?

default.0: #bPhoebe#k has all the details you need to know!
